h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kamarhati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kamarhati

c: Kamarhati lies on the Hooghly just north of Kolkata, and its old jute mill colonies still house many families close to the river. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to mill colonies, housing societies, schools, clubs and municipal parks in Kamarhati. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away, and come to West Bengal by road.

Riverside ground in the Kolkata belt stays damp for long spells, and the monsoon is heavy. A gym here should sit on a slightly raised, firm base with drainage around it. Our frames are galvanised and our seats roto-moulded, both made for wet weather. The equipment is fitted by our installation team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing. Send us photos of the site and tell us whether water collects there after rain.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on damp ground near the river?
items.a: Yes, with a raised and well-drained base. We grout the footing below the soft top layer, and the layout drawing shows where drains or a raised pad will help.

items.q: Which machines should a para club start with?
items.a: Three or four machines covering legs, arms and waist make a good first set. Combination stations such as Tai Chi with a standing twister save space and money.
Yes. We send the equipment from our factory in Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
